earnings.title: Release: October 28, 2026
highlights: Calgary – Canadian Pacific Kansas City (TSX: CP) (NYSE: CP) (CPKC) today announced its third-quarter results, including revenues of $4.2 billion, diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $1.04 and core adjusted diluted EPS 1 of $1.28.
Revenues increased 15 percent to $4.2 billion from $3.7 billion in Q3 2025
Reported diluted EPS increased 3 percent to $1.04 from $1.01 in Q3 2025
Core adjusted diluted EPS 1 increased 16 percent to $1.28 from $1.10 in Q3 2025

quotes.text: CPKC delivered solid results, powered by momentum across our unrivalled North American network, countering macroeconomic headwinds during the quarter.
quotes.by: Keith Creel, CPKC President and Chief Executive Officer

items.heading: As a common carrier, the Company is required by law to transport dangerous goods and hazardous materials, which could expose the Company to significant costs and claims.
The Company faces competition from other transportation providers and failure to compete effectively could adversely affect financial results.
The operations of carriers with which the Company interchanges may adversely affect operations.
The Company may be affected by acts of terrorism, war, or risk of war.
The Company is affected by fluctuating fuel prices.
